facts.fact: KRAY 周一上午 9:30 准点抵达新总部大楼的反间谍组（CEG）问询室门外。
facts.anchor: KRAY arrived outside the Counterespionage Group interview room in the New Headquarters Building at exactly 9:30 on Monday morning

facts.fact: 到之前他先去 EVERSHAG 办公室，趁她开会把银拆信刀放回她的桌面。
facts.anchor: slipping her silver letter opener back onto her desk while she was away at a meeting

facts.fact: 给 KRAY 发问询室房号的 FURST 把真名与化名 Hugo N. FURST 都写进了邮件。
facts.anchor: had put both his true name and his Funny Name, which was Hugo N. FURST, into his email

facts.fact: 这一写等于 FURST 亲手吹掉了自己的化名。
facts.anchor: In so doing he had blown his own pseudo

facts.fact: FURST 把他领进一间无窗小屋，天花板一角装着摄像头。
facts.anchor: ushered him to a small, windowless room with a camera up in one corner of the ceiling

facts.fact: FURST 说 KRAY 的上级告知他：KRAY 未报告在印度与一名外国情报官的会面。
facts.anchor: failed to report a meeting in India with a foreign intel officer

facts.fact: KRAY 把事情全讲了，只略去金打火机那一段。
facts.anchor: He told him everything, minus the gold lighter part

facts.fact: 问询结束时 FURST 看表，时间是 9:43，全程十三分钟。
